subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: Dr. Muhammad Kudrat-E-Khuda was born in Birbhum, West Bengal. In 1947 he came to Bangladesh and became the first director of Public Instruction. After the independence of Bangladesh, he was made the chairman of Education Commission. He was appointed visiting professor of Dhaka University. The government of Bangladesh honoured him with 'Ekushey Padak' and 'Swadhinata Dibas Puraskar'.
